TITLE: ERNIE 5.0 Technical Report  
AUTHORS: ERNIE Team, Baidu  
ONE-LINE TAKEAWAY: ERNIE 5.0 is the first publicly disclosed production-scale trillion-parameter unified autoregressive foundation model that supports both multimodal understanding and generation across text, image, video, and audio.  
- Existing models often restrict output to text-centric formats, limiting multimodal interaction capabilities.  
- Late-fusion designs decouple multimodal generation from understanding and hinder deep cross-modal integration.  
- Unified autoregressive backbone with ultra-sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture.  
- Modality-agnostic expert routing based on unified token representations.  
- Next-Group-of-Tokens Prediction objective for joint training of all modalities.  
- Elastic training paradigm enabling a single pre-training run to produce sub-models with varying depths, widths, and sparsity.  
- Multi-stage post-training combining supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and unified multimodal reinforcement learning (UMRL).  
- ERNIE 5.0 achieves strong and balanced performance across multiple modalities.  
- Reducing routing top-k to 25% during inference yields over 15% decoding speedup with only minor accuracy loss.  
- Elastic training preserves near-full performance using only 53.7% activated parameters and 35.8% total parameters.  
- 15% decoding speedup: achieved by reducing routing top-k to 25% during inference.  
- 53.7% activated parameters: fraction of parameters used in elastic sub-models while preserving near-full performance.  
- 35.8% total parameters: fraction of full model size used in elastic sub-models.  
- Trillion-parameter: size of ERNIE 5.0, making it the first publicly disclosed production-scale unified autoregressive model.  
- Figure 1: Architecture of ERNIE 5.0 showing shared backbone, modality-specific encoders/decoders, and ultra-sparse MoE with modality-agnostic routing.
